decision_semantics: CONDITIONAL refers to the existence of an alternative D-1 00Z model-level archive that is causally available (347/347 origins) but operationally misaligned with the locked Stage 8.1 lead-time protocol (+25h..+48h vs +7h..+30h).
final_scientific_conclusion: True MEPS model-level cloud condensate was not demonstrated to be usable for a Stage 8.10B experiment under the locked POLARIS causal-availability and lead-time protocol because the intended D-1 18Z model-level archive has 0/347 empirical coverage. The alternative D-1 00Z archive is available but changes the information set through a materially longer forecast lead time and therefore does not constitute a clean continuation of the locked benchmark.
